### The Importance of Pentecost
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/importance-pentecost
Passage: Deuteronomy 16:16-17
Points:
- Deuteronomy 16 designates three major pilgrimage festivals where God's people were required to assemble before Him.
- Gathering corporately for these feasts united the community in shared worship and joy.
- Old Testament celebrations of grain harvest and law point forward to the outpouring of the Holy Spirit.
- Recognizing the Lord as the source of every provision prompts generosity toward God and those in need.
- Believers should never approach God presumptuously or empty-handed, but with grateful hearts.
